title: Workflow-phase improvements added to one skill file are not mirrored to all three canonical skill files
description: When the Reasoning Reviewer spec (moeb.reasoning-reviewer) was authored, Phase 5b (Reasoning Review) was added only to run.skill.md. The equivalent phase was not added to spec.skill.md or fix_signal.skill.md, meaning reasoning quality monitoring would be absent for spec and fix_signal invocations. The root cause is a missing convention: there is no spec-authoring guideline or rubric criterion that requires the author to explicitly consider whether a new workflow phase applies to all three canonical skill files (run, spec, fix_signal) and, if so, to include Steps for all three. Any future workflow improvement that should apply universally — reviewer phases, metrics steps, budget checks — is at risk of being added to only one skill file.
proposed_resolution: Add a rubric criterion `all-skill-files-parity` to the global rubric (src/moeb/internal/rubrics/global.rubrics.md) that mandates: whenever a spec adds, removes, or modifies a workflow phase in any one of the three canonical skill files (run.skill.md, spec.skill.md, fix_signal.skill.md), the spec must contain an explicit Step for each of the other two files — either applying the equivalent change or documenting with rationale why that file is intentionally excluded. The criterion fails if a phase change appears in only one skill file with no documented exclusion rationale for the other two.
